definitions.gloss: blending; compounding; mixing in specific proportions
definitions.explanation: The act of combining ingredients or substances in precise ratios to create a mixture or formulation. Commonly used in cooking, chemistry, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{配合|はいごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ビタミン→ビタミン：09770_bitamin⟧C⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{配合|はいごう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{化粧水|けしょうすい}→化粧水：15802_keshousui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a lotion formulated with vitamin C.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配合|はいごう}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えたら→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: When we changed the blending ratio of the ingredients, the flavor changed dramatically.

notes:
USAGE:
{配合|はいごう} emphasizes mixing in precise proportions, unlike general mixing (⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧). It is common in product descriptions, recipes, and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配合|はいごう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to blend / to compound
- {配合|はいごう}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: blending ratio
- {配合|はいごう}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount blended in
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{配合|はいごう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧: formulated with ~

FORMS:
{配|はい} (distribute) + ⟦{合|ごう}→合：27628_gou⟧ (combine).
